mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.create_date as createDate, b.update_date as updateDate, b.writer_id as writerId, m.name as writerName FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_id = m.id ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.create_date as createDate, b.update_date as updateDate, b.writer_id as writerId, m.name as writerName FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_id = m.id ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.create_date as createDate, b.update_date as updateDate, b.writer_id as writerId, m.name as writerName FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_id = m.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (title, content, writer_id, create_date, update_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writerId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, board_id as boardId, original_name as originalName, stored_name as storedName, file_size as fileSize FROM board_file WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
SELECT id, board_id as boardId, original_name as originalName, stored_name as storedName, file_size as fileSize FROM board_file WHERE id = #{fileId}
SELECT id, board_id as boardId, original_name as originalName, stored_name as storedName, file_size as fileSize FROM board_file WHERE stored_name = #{storedName}
